query: INSERT INTO tabac_molecule_links (tabac_id, molecule_id, concentration, notes, created_at) SELECT t.id, m.id, 0.8, 'Terpene majeur du Perique fermente', NOW() FROM tabacs t, molecules m WHERE t.name LIKE '%Perique%' AND m.name LIKE '%linalool%' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = VALUES(notes);
